full_name: Elizabeth Dyrud Lyman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Humanities Jeanne Rosselet Fellow and Bunting Fellow Harvard University
bio: Elizabeth Dyrud Lyman’s scholarly interests revolve around the fragmentary and imperfect notational systems through which artists express and interpret nonlinguistic ideas.
